title.narrative: Technical and institutional capacity-building for increasing production and developing the aquaculture and fisheries value chains in Ethiopia

description.narrative: Institutional capacity building for inclusive and sustainable industrial development is a priority of the Government of Ethiopia (GoE) national development plans. This project is proposed on request of government of Ethiopia - Ministry of Fisheries and Livestock Development (MoFLD) and Ministry of Industry and Trade (MoIT), to support implementation of the Industrialization led national Agriculture Transformation Plan (ATP) and related sector strategies. The project is also linked to the implementation framework of the Integrated Agro Industry Parks (ATP-IAIP) strategy, and the Aquaculture and Fisheries sector development strategy. Specifically, the project is aiming to promote fisheries value addition with a long term agenda of sustained nutritional food security, transformation of rural livelihoods and enhanced export market access. The project objective is to develop institutional capacity via the establishment of a Fisheries and Aquaculture Training and Vocational Institute (FATVI) to support an upgraded fisheries sector; and contribute to establishing of national human resource capacity for the sustainable promotion, efficient use and management of the fisheries sector and developing of associated fishing support industry and fish processing value chains.
